flagged.title: Colour, Decoration & Finishes
flagged.reason: The video explicitly instructs GCSE students to name-drop the invented 'UK Night Clothes Safety Regulations' in their exam rather than the actual Nightwear (Safety) Regulations 1985.

mark_affecting.quote: A flame-retardant finish is a legal requirement for children's nightwear under the UK Night Clothes Safety Regulations. This is a massive takeaway for you. Whenever you're discussing fabric finishes in your exam, you absolutely want to name drop specific legislation like this.
under the UK Night Clothes Safety Regulations
